verdict.rationale: Cloudflare ships an official Sandbox SDK with extensive first-party API docs. Covered methods include getSandbox(), exec() with streaming and stdin, readFile/writeFile with ReadableStream, sessions, the code interpreter, watch(), ports and tunnels, and an architecture page describing the SDK's transport protocols. missing for 10: evidence of official SDKs beyond the Workers JavaScript/TypeScript SDK (e.g. Python or other languages), independent hands-on corroboration of building with the SDK.
